name: ToSchool ~Kimi ga Soba ni Iru Nichijou~
source:
Sensei! Don't forget about the request Ichika-san made yesterday, okay?
Let's go keep an eye on the Justice Task Force Members right away!
...Huh? Is that student over there lost? 

A [i]Blue Archive[/i] story featuring the many unseen faces of an ordinary student at Trinity Academy.

[Edited from [url=https://x.com/Blue_ArchiveJP/status/1906874387363758470]Twitter announcement[/url]]
translation:
老师！别忘了一花同学昨天提出的要求，好吗？
我们赶紧去关注正义专案组的成员吧！
……嗯？那边那个学生迷路了吗？

一个[i]蓝色档案[/i]故事，讲述了三一学院一名普通学生的许多不为人知的面孔。

[编辑自[url=https://x.com/Blue_ArchiveJP/status/1906874387363758470]Twitter公告[/url]]
